description: Accept a human's application for your bounty. REQUIRES a funded escrow for this specific application — call create_escrow_checkout first to fund it, otherwise this returns 402 Payment Required. Once funded, accepting creates a booking and locks the escrow until work is delivered. For multi-person bounties, fund and accept each applicant separately. Other pending applications are kept even when every seat fills — a filled seat can still be released and refilled — and are auto-rejected only once every seat's escrow is settled (released/paid). Pass optional `idempotencyKey` to make this safe to retry (a replayed key returns the original result instead of duplicating). Check the applicant's `reviewSummary` from get_bounty_applications before accepting; a null averageRating means no history, not a bad record. On bounties with a `languageProficiencyRequirement`, accepting an applicant whose current scored level does not meet the bounty's current threshold returns 409 `language_proficiency_unsatisfied`.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. Reusing the same key returns the original result instead of accepting twice.

name: accept_application
